subject: Statusbar is too small in OSX

messages.author: 21c3cab9e32899a7
messages.subject: Statusbar is too small in OSX
parts:
Hi rattle users,

I'm using OSX 10.7.3, and I've installed rattle using pkg file posted
at http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/.

But when I launch rattle using library(rattle) then rattle(), I get
rattle window with pretty small status bar which can barely display
texts on it.
(Please see the attached screenshot).

Is it common problem or just me?

If it's just me, how can I fix it?

Please advise.

Thanks
Minkoo

messages.subject: Re: Statusbar is too small in OSX

Hi Minkoo,

I'm not a regular Mac user but when I do I always notice this. I don't
know why it is so small nor do I know how to fix it, but I hope one
day to find the solution.

Regards,
Graham
